description: Forward geocoding for Italian addresses. Searches the ANNCSU street archive (18.7+ million addresses) by street name and optional municipality. Returns matches with WGS84 coordinates, postal code, municipality, province and region. Does NOT find points of interest: search by street name instead.

q.description: Street name or search text, min 2 chars. Example: "Via del Corso"

name: zornade_geocode_search
title: Geocode Italian addresses
